Built for Franklin

Not a national directory with a Franklin label. Profiles, local tools, participation paths and membership are organized around the Franklin community itself.

  • Free factual profile review and corrections
  • Clear local participation tools
  • Simple Community Membership choices

Profile help

Find the existing listing, suggest a factual correction for free, or request the accurately labeled create-profile path.

Profile help

Recurring membership

Monthly and annual members must be able to update payment methods, view billing history and cancel future renewals through secure member tools.

Three-year term

The prepaid 36-month option does not automatically renew. Franklin Navigator must provide 60-, 30- and 7-day expiration reminders and a fresh renewal choice.

Payment problems and refunds

Payment failure, recovery, cancellation, refund and entitlement state must reconcile accurately before general checkout opens. The final owner-approved three-year refund policy remains a launch gate and will be published before any three-year payment is accepted.

Language and accessibility

Support may be requested in English or Spanish. Tell us about an accessibility barrier at community@franklinnavigator.com.
